title: Ecoasis Sans (Shaded)
description: A sans-based shaded x32 font pack for the Ecoasis collection.
body:
Howdy y'all, Here is the ~~first part in my Ecoasis resource pack collection plan~~ shaded version of [Ecoasis Sans](https://modrinth.com/project/5rhN6GwY)!
It is intended to be paired with my Ecoasis modpack (work in progress), but can comfortably be used by itself. **Ecoasis Sans** is a x32 resolution Minecraft font that is loosely based on the free **[Averia Sans Libre](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Averia+Sans+Libre)** font.
Currently only the `ascii.png` file has been retextured, but support for more unicode and special characters will come in future updates. ![The Ascii text characters displayed in-game.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/419bbfe194783e951f714e721f64515f6fd3db7b.png) **Regular Version: [Ecoasis Sans](https://modrinth.com/project/5rhN6GwY)** Enjoy :)
